name: [💎600M] Bubble Gum Simulator INFINITY
desc:
Welcome to Bubble Gum Simulator INFINITY! 🫧

🎃 Halloween Part 2 is here!

🎃 New Halloween Season Pass! 4x Secret & Mythic Chance!
🥚 New Luminant Egg! + the return of a very popular Luminance Pet...
🍀 New Global Egg Luck! The more players hatching the Luminant Egg, the luckier it is!
🔮 Faster Bubbling, XL Luck, & Void Luck Super Enchants!
💎 New Level Up Pack Rebirths! When the Level Up Pack is maxed out, unlock the stronger Rebirth Pack!
⭐ New Bundle, Level Up Pack, & Exclusive Pets! Exclusive Pets can now be sold in XL Variants after the Mythic Sells out!
🎃 New OG Sinister Lord 2.0 Pet obtainable for being in the Top 25 Halloween Rebirth Leaderboard daily!
🏆 Halloween Milestones + Pass!
⚙️ Even more QOL Updates!

⭐ Updates every Friday at 2PM EST!

☁️ Blow Bubble Gum to increase its size and jump into the clouds. Discover islands and secrets in the sky!

🥚 Hatch rare pets and build a powerful pet team!

A game by Rumble Studios.
